RegExp v flag: The app's engine has no `v` (unicodeSets) flag: `new RegExp("a", "v")` and a /x/v literal are a SyntaxError there. The kit runs V8, which accepts it. Do not use it.
array sort inconsistent comparator: A comparator that contradicts itself (`() => -1`, `() => 1`) orders differently: the app's engine and V8 sort with different algorithms. Consistent comparators, and the sort being stable, behave the same.
stack overflow error name: Runaway recursion throws `InternalError` in the app and `RangeError` in the kit. Catch it by `e instanceof Error`, not by name.
Error.stackTraceLimit: V8 only builds `Error.stack` while `Error.stackTraceLimit` exists, so the kit keeps it; the app has none. Do not read it.
URL internationalized host: The app's URL has no punycode: `new URL("http://münchen.de")` is a TypeError there. The kit turns the host into `xn--mnchen-3ya.de`. Write such hosts in their `xn--` form.
global object prototype: In the app `Object.getPrototypeOf(globalThis) === Object.prototype`; in the kit's vm context it is not. Nothing a plugin should depend on.
large: array fill 1e7: A plugin has 64 MB of memory in the app (PluginEnv.memoryLimitBytes); a 1e7-element array is 80 MB and throws InternalError. The kit has no such limit.
large: regex replace to 2 MB: Memory limit of 64 MB in the app (PluginEnv.memoryLimitBytes); this replace builds a 2 MB string many times over and throws InternalError there. The kit has no such limit.
large: nested array depth 5000 JSON: The app's JSON.parse/stringify handle 5000 nested arrays; V8 inside the kit's vm context overflows its stack (RangeError).
large: recursion depth 5000: The app's stack is 1 MB (PluginEnv.maxStackBytes): 5000 nested calls already throw InternalError. The kit gives V8's ~10000 frames.
large: recursion depth 50000: Both engines throw, with a different name: InternalError in the app, RangeError in the kit.
large: object with 1e6 keys: Memory limit of 64 MB in the app (PluginEnv.memoryLimitBytes); an object with 1e6 keys throws InternalError there. The kit has no such limit.
large: Map with 1e6 entries: Memory limit of 64 MB in the app (PluginEnv.memoryLimitBytes); a Map with 1e6 entries fails there (the error has no name). The kit has no such limit.
